text:
Elena R: Quick sync — we need a compact private-offer template for SI deals that ties onboarding credits to a staged renewal gating. goal: reduce upfront credits but preserve ARR retention signals. thoughts?
Samir K: I like staged credits. ex: 3-month trial credit, then milestone-triggered top-up for 6–12mo commit. ties incentives to usage ramp.
Maria P: @Elena @Samir can we also make the top-ups conditional on hitting a usage velocity threshold (e.g., embeddings + gen tokens)? Otherwise we subsidize inactive pilots.
Ben L: +1. For marketplace private offers we should map the thresholds to the partner SKU so billing is clean. also need approval matrix for >20% effective discount.
Elena R: Proposed gating rules (sketch):
```
phase_1: onboarding_credit = 20% of first quarter spend
phase_2: if usage velocity >= 50% of forecast -> apply 10% top-up credit on next invoice
renewal_gate: if 6mo avg usage >= 60% of committed -> renewal discount tier 1 else tier 2
```
Not final, just a starting point.
Samir K: Can we add a hard cap for total credits per customer? and a cliff where if no activity after 90d we pull the credits back (i.e., stop future top-ups).
Maria P: cap = min(credits, 30% of initial commit) looks reasonable. For the cliff, tie it to active infra (e.g., model deployed + at least 1 production route). prevents gaming.
Ben L: Ops note — marketplace private-offer flows often block custom credit fields. PartnerOps Bot can we surface a list of SKUs that support credit attachments per marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure)?
PartnerOps Bot: Sure — pulling SKU compatibility now. I'll DM the table to this thread in a sec. :gear: 
Elena R: Also need messaging for SIs: "credits are performance-backed and refundable only by meeting milestones" — ensures they sell technical onboarding too, not just credits.
Maria P: Sales enablement draft: short playbook + example customer narrative. I'll draft and share by EOD.
Samir K: Engineering ask — is there a simple flag we can emit to billing when milestone achieved? e.g., `si_onboard_topup=true` so downstream reconciliation is easier.
Ben L: @eng-platform do we have that primitive? If not, create a small webhook between partner ops and billing to apply top-up.
Elena R: Action items:
- Maria: draft playbook + partner-facing language (due EOD)
- Ben: confirm marketplace SKU compatibility and approval thresholds (due 48h)
- Samir: spec the billing flag/webhook and a cap enforcement approach (due 5 business days)
- PartnerOps Bot: post SKU table
Maria P: noted, will get the playbook + simple examples (customer A/B) up today. :rocket:
Samir K: I'll ping @eng-platform privately for feasibility.
Ben L: Thanks — this should keep credits targeted and avoid runaway subsidy. :thumbsup:
Elena R: If no objections, I'll turn this into a private-offer template and a renewal gating annex. planning to circulate Monday for final sign-off.
Maria P: no objections from me.
PartnerOps Bot: SKU compatibility table posted to DM (sent).
